title: Hue
summary: HUE, noun Color; dye. Flow'rs of all hue HUE, in the phrase hue and cry, signifies a shouting or vociferation. In law, a hue and cry is the pursuit of a felon or offender, with loud outcries or clamor

inlines.v: HUE, noun Color; dye. Flow'rs of all hue HUE, in the phrase hue and cry, signifies a shouting or vociferation. In law, a hue and cry is the pursuit of a felon or offender, with loud outcries or clamor to give an alarm.
